name: one_primary_one_backup_strategy
principle: Run one primary tool by default. Use the backup tool only for sampling, blind-spot coverage, or confirmation. Do not run two active tools full-scope by default.

scope.notes: Classification and scope decisions must have one source of truth.

subdomain.notes: Run low-rate DNS discovery in the full one-click flow, then feed resolved hosts through scope confirmation before HTTP probing.

alive_probe.notes: Do not run two liveness probes full-scope unless the first output is incomplete.

fingerprint.notes: Use httpx technology detection one target at a time with an outer delay; keep runner rules as fallback categories.

product_aware_triage.notes: Identify the specific OA/ERP/CMS/framework/middleware product offline, then map it to a bounded tool branch. Never launch product exploit templates automatically.

fingerprint_deepening.notes: Map detected products/frameworks to safe follow-up checks, local tool/template candidates, command previews, and approval gates. Do not execute tools automatically.

crawl_api_js.notes: One-click enables Katana with depth=2, concurrency=1, parallelism=1, rate-limit=1, and delay; built-in parsing still normalizes candidates.

wechat_miniapp_discovery.notes: Generate mini-program, official-account, QR-code, and search-dork clues. Feed only authorized source domains from wechat_subdomain_scan_targets.txt back into subdomain/alive scanning; keep WeChat platform and third-party links pending review.

api_endpoint_confirm.notes: Confirm bounded GET-like API candidates only. Skip risky verbs such as upload, import, export, download, delete, update, save, pay, password, and file.

xss_candidate_screening.notes: Build XSS candidates from discovered parameterized URLs and optionally send one inert GET marker per safe parameter. Stored/blind/script-payload validation and full-scope external scanners are not default automation.

authenticated_session_review.notes: The runner creates a manual login/registration queue. After the operator supplies a valid local session file, review same-host JS and bounded GET-like APIs. Never persist cookies, response values, or downloaded files.

healthcare_privacy_triage.notes: Prioritize patient identity, encounter, diagnosis, prescription, LIS/PACS, billing, insurance, follow-up, and mental-health field names. Store endpoint paths, parameter names, field names, counts, and hashes only; never retain patient values, bodies, reports, or images.

high_value_paths.notes: Keep the path set small and deterministic.

truth_verify.notes: Use one consistent scoring algorithm to avoid inconsistent claims.

template_validation.notes: Use the pinned managed Nuclei engine and reviewed templates as the general core; use afrog mainly for confirmed Chinese OA products. Filter by technology, severity, and intrusiveness, and never run approval-gated templates automatically.

shiro_candidate_screening.notes: Detect Shiro rememberMe behavior with baseline GET plus invalid rememberMe cookie only. Do not brute force keys or send serialized payloads in the default flow.

shiro_validation.notes: Use only on one authorized candidate target at a time for key/rememberMe verification. Command execution, memory shell, upload, and persistence features are approval-gated and disabled by default.

sqli_candidate_screening.notes: Retain the shallow SQLi check but do not launch broad or proactive SQL injection scanning. Test only already-discovered parameterized GET URLs with strict per-host, parameter, request, delay, and stop limits. Never enumerate databases or retrieve data; 500/status deltas are candidates, not proof.

sqli_validation.notes: Use only on one high-probability or operator-approved candidate URL at a time with risk=1, level=1, technique BE, delay, request caps, and no database dumping or destructive options.

springboot_candidate_screening.notes: Read-only fingerprint plus actuator endpoint probes (env/heapdump only as status-code existence checks). Do not download heapdump files or dump memory in the default flow.

springboot_validation.notes: CLI: python tools/managed/springbootscan/SpringBoot-Scan-main/SpringBoot-Scan.py -u <url> (GitHub AabyssZG v2.7.2; needs Defender exclusion for its inc/poc.py which is flagged Exploit:Python/SpringShell.SGA!MSR - verified enabled on this host). Headless use: pipe an empty/0 line to answer the interactive delay prompt (e.g. echo '0' | python SpringBoot-Scan.py -u <url>). -v/-d exploit and heapdump-download modes are approval-gated. Nuclei springboot actuator set is the backup: detection-only downloads (heapdump/env/logfile content-feature checks, never archived). Verified on local sim: 8 actuator infoleak URLs found; nuclei heapdump critical hit.

fastjson_candidate_screening.notes: Read-only deformatter checks only (type error, syntax error, nested parse). No RCE payloads or DNS lookups in the default flow.

fastjson_validation.notes: CLI only: FastjsonScan.exe -u <url> [-o result.txt]. Detects version ranges (1.2.48/1.2.68/1.2.80), autoType status, dependency library, and error/DNS/latency probes. Any real RCE/out-of-band exploitation beyond probes is approval-gated. Use on one authorized candidate at a time.

struts2_candidate_screening.notes: Read-only fingerprint probes only: default action suffix, showcase, devMode, OGNL error markers. No exploitation or OGNL evaluation in the default flow.

struts2_validation.notes: CLI only: python tools/managed/struts2scan/Struts2-Scan-master/Struts2Scan.py -u <url> for S2-001-S2-057 plus devMode (local copy patched: -n name check uses s2_dict instead of class list to fix always-unsupported bug). Nuclei backup covers S2-045/S2-057/S2-061/S2-062 and executes payloads (cat /etc/passwd matcher) - intrusive, approval-gated. Verified end-to-end on local sim: 4/4 struts CVE templates hit.

tomcat_weblogic_candidate_screening.notes: Read-only probes: TCP connect checks for ajp 8009, t3 7001, http 8080 plus version/manager/console existence markers. No payloads.

tomcat_weblogic_validation.notes: Pinned managed Nuclei engine with reviewed templates only: ghostcat CVE-2020-1938 (network), weblogic CVE-2019-2725/CVE-2020-14882/CVE-2018-2894/CVE-2023-21839, tomcat manager/default-login/jolokia-creds-leak. Verified end-to-end on local sim: ghostcat critical hit; CVE-2020-14882 critical hit and CVE-2023-21839 high hit via self-hosted interactsh (public oast.pro unreachable from this network). Local OOB stack: interactsh-server -d 127.0.0.1 -http-port 8000 -dns-port 30053 -lip 127.0.0.1 -sa (domain MUST equal the nuclei server IP form, i.e. -d 127.0.0.1, else DNS callbacks are not matched), then nuclei -iserver http://127.0.0.1:8000. Independent CLI for 21839: tools\managed\weblogic21839\POC_CVE-2023-21839\CVE-2023-21839.py -ip <t> -p 7001 -l ldap://<oast>/x (pure T3/IIOP handshake, verified 7/7 steps on sim). Approval-gated RCE templates never auto-run; per-host template caps apply.

nacos_candidate_screening.notes: Read-only probe of a small set of admin/console endpoints; record status codes and key-value existence only, never contents of sensitive configuration.

nacos_validation.notes: Pinned managed Nuclei templates only: nacos-auth-bypass, nacos-authentication-bypass, nacos-info-leak, nacos-create-user, nacos-default-login. Do not create users or mutate configuration in the default flow; those require explicit approval.

redis_es_zk_candidate_screening.notes: Read-only probes: Redis PING/INFO banner, Elasticsearch GET / status, ZooKeeper connect + ruok. No command execution, no data reads beyond banners.

redis_es_zk_validation.notes: Pinned managed Nuclei templates only: exposed-redis/redis-config/redis-info, elasticsearch detect and known info-leak templates. Actual key/value reads or config writes require explicit approval.

custom_probe_policy.notes: Custom scripts such as vuln_sqli_pure.py, vuln_lfi.py, vuln_rce.py, vuln_ssti.py, weak_passwd_scanner.py, and upload/RCE helpers are not authoritative validators by default. Use them as low-rate candidate screeners or wrappers, then validate with a mature tool, manual request review, or explicit approval-gated minimal proof.

directory_fuzz.notes: Use small curated wordlists and low rate. Avoid broad recursion by default.

report.notes: Review priority_targets.json and run_health.json before report drafting.

credential_testing.notes: Credential spraying and brute force remain approval-gated. Custom credential scripts are helpers only; they are not default validators and must use tiny dictionaries, low rate, and lockout-safe limits.

exploitability.notes: Stop once permission or impact is proven. Custom exploit helpers must not be used full-scope and should only assist one approved candidate at a time.

post_exploitation.notes: Webshell, C2, tunnels, internal scanning, and persistence are not default workflow tools.
